model: nodewise ridge; physical cell independent row
support_rule: No SoC extrapolation: no finite training voltage at node => NaN
research_scope: offline retrospective-normalized voltage representation; not online BMS evaluation
notes: Outer factor-level holdouts exclude all withheld cells
Inner folds contain only outer training cells
Equal cell weighting in metric; alpha selected by cell-level 3-fold CV
Payload size excludes support masks and model metadata
